1. Claim 4 (Currently Amended): A method of impeding Leishmania transmission comprising administering to a subject a composition comprising Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fractions or sub-fractions derived from __Leishmania donovani__ promastigotes or amastigotes and saponin, wherein said composition is formulated as a blocking vaccine __specifically for use in canine subjects__.

2. Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a blocking vaccine __in canine subjects to impede Leishmania transmission__.

3. Claim 6 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a reagent, wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission __in canine subjects__.

4. Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 4, wherein the Leishmania donovani promastigotes or Leishmania donovani amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, amino acids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
